title: Bridge docs for component upgrades: UX heuristics, migration recipes, token mapping
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: produce a set of "bridge" documentation pages that help engineers and designers upgrade from legacy component patterns (legacy tokens, v1 buttons, table variants, and chart wrappers) to our current component library APIs and token semantics. The intent is pragmatic: minimize friction for product teams during rollouts by providing mapping tables, small migration recipes, clear do/don't guidance, and a compatibility shim playbook.

Scope: tokens (semantic mapping, fallbacks), buttons (legacy props -> new variants, accessibility delta), tables (pagination, row actions, responsive patterns), charts (data shape expectations, small-to-large variants). Deliverables are documentation pages + code snippets + 1 interactive sandbox per component family. These pages will live under the docs ‘Migration & Compatibility’ section and link to component API reference and the console examples.

Why this ticket exists: recent engineering rollouts (runtime and API surface) required minor contract changes to several components and token names. Product teams are now reporting regressions or inconsistent styling when they upgrade. Rather than slow the rollout, we ship docs that: 1) show exact field->field mappings, 2) provide tiny code recipes to perform automated codemod-friendly updates, and 3) document tradeoffs and known edge cases.

Non-goals: exhaustive design rationale for each token; feature redesigns. This is a bridge and migration set of notes, intended for short-term migrations with links to longer-term pattern work.
acceptance_criteria: A concise token parity matrix published with examples showing legacyToken -> semanticToken mappings for color, spacing and type
Button migration page with 6 code recipes (v1->v2 props, icon-only, group migration, disabled states, keyboard/accessibility notes, visual regression checks)
Table migration recipes that include examples for: server-side pagination adapter, selection model migration, and responsive column collapse
Charts document showing data shape changes, example adapters for Vega-lite->internal chart wrapper, and recommended snapshot tests for regression monitoring
Each page includes at least one interactive sandbox (CodeSandbox/StackBlitz or embedded playground) and a linked quick codemod script in the repo
Docs reviewed and approved by: Eng owners (frontend infra), PM owner for the product area, and Accessibility reviewer

decisions: Prefer semantic tokens as the canonical mapping and provide CSS variable fallback snippets for immediate parity
Do not attempt automatic prop coercion in the component runtime; provide codemods and small shim utilities instead to keep runtime stable
Provide an opt-in 'compat' CDK in the docs for teams that need faster migration; mark it deprecated in 12 months
Interactive sandboxes will use mocked network/data rather than production datasets to avoid any PII concerns
